name: Vista Kids Dental
outcome: 3 patient journeys: discover the practice, find aftercare, and request a visit.

caseStudy.problem: Families need to understand a pediatric dental practice, find post-operative guidance, and request an appointment without searching through disconnected information.
caseStudy.whatWeBuilt: A patient-focused website connecting the practice homepage, post-operative guidance, and appointment request page across desktop and mobile.
caseStudy.results: 3 key patient journeys are brought together in a single website: practice discovery, aftercare guidance, and appointment requests. All 3 are documented at desktop and mobile sizes. Booking and patient-growth data have not been supplied.
